name: ovos-tool-adapters
description: Bridges **MCP** (Model Context Protocol) and **UTCP** (Universal Tool Calling Protocol) servers into the OVOS agentic loop as standard `ToolBox` plugins.
author: OpenVoiceOS

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-tool-adapters[mcp]    # MCP support
pip install ovos-tool-adapters[utcp]   # UTCP support
pip install ovos-tool-adapters[mcp,utcp]
